summary: Dublin, Ireland, software developer, Python programming, open source software advocate, member of TOG Hackerspace, strong interest in Linux and FLOSS (Free/Libre Open Source Software), frequent traveler within Europe, critical of corporate practices (especially in tech), engaged in discussions about digital rights and privacy, interest in A/B testing and user experience design, advocates for free access to information and education, has volunteered with Camara (charity for education in Africa), enjoys cycling, has a background in statistics and data analysis.
